newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Pacific enters settlement with Kidder.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Pacific enters settlement with Kidder.

text.p: Bonneville Pacific Corp, which is in Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection, said on Friday it had reached a settlement for Kidder Peabody & Co to pay Bonneville Pacific $15 million.
Bonneville filed for Chapter 11 in 1991, when the company owed investors and creditors $400 million. The company has since entered settlements with many of its advisors.
Bonneville's bankruptcy trustee alleges that Bonneville's advisors conspired to inflate the value of its assets and file fraudulent statements with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The settlement is subject to court approval.
Kidder Peabody is owned by PaineWebber Group Inc. General Electric Co, which previously owned Kidder Peabody, now owns about 25 percent of PaineWebber.
